title: Vanderbilt BIEN Lab Peri-ictal Dynamics Data (Makhoul et al. 2025): per-seizure SEEG partial directed coherence and imaginary coherence
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG dataset of per-seizure connectivity results computed from stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings of patients with drug-resistant epilepsy evaluated at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. It contains partial directed coherence and imaginary coherence across six frequency bands, computed in sliding windows for peri-ictal and interictal periods. Seizure-onset and propagation zone labels accompany each seizure. The files support analysis of interictal suppressive networks and seizure spread.
methods_description: SEEG channels were re-referenced to a bipolar montage and bandpass filtered with fifth-order Butterworth filters. Partial directed coherence was computed from 5 s windows of grey-matter channels with a 1 s stride across six frequency bands (delta through high gamma). For each seizure, 10 min before onset, the ictal period and 10 min after offset were analyzed, together with an interictal clip.
